limitations.note: The warning outputs remained combinational instead of being registered on the rising edge from the pre-update balance and sampled boost input.
The rewrite deducted a fee on recharge cycles, changing the original behavior in which `set` adds money without deducting a fee that cycle.
The test expected red to change when boost changed between clock edges and expected a fee on recharge cycles, so it validated the rewrite's assumptions rather than the intended behavior.
